app.name: SiteOps Radar
app.description: Analyze performance, SEO, security, accessibility, and AI search readiness in one place.

projects.title: Manage projects and competitors
projects.subtitle: Register your site and competitor sites so analysis results can be compared with the same scoring model.
projects.emptyProjects: No sites have been registered yet.
projects.emptyCompetitors: Add competitor sites to power gap analysis.
projects.storageNotice: Manage all your sites in one place and compare them alongside competitors.
projects.actionGuide: The selected site's competitors and recent analysis runs appear in the panels below.
projects.saveError: The project could not be saved.
projects.deleteError: The project could not be deleted.

auth.title: Sign in to SiteOps Radar
auth.subtitle: Use Google sign-in to lock the workspace for personal use and manage projects and analysis history under your account.
auth.localModeDescription: In development, you can use the local test account to move quickly without Google OAuth.
auth.freeModeDescription: Try the public audit without signing in, then unlock saved projects and the full report after login.
auth.googleNotConfigured: Google OAuth is not connected yet. Add the client ID and secret to enable this button.
auth.googleAllowlistRequired: If needed, use AUTHORIZED_EMAILS to restrict which Google accounts can sign in.
auth.googleTemporarilyUnavailable: Google sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Check the environment configuration.

errors.AccessDenied: This account is not in the current sign-in allowlist.
errors.CredentialsSignin: The local development login email does not match.
errors.default: Something went wrong while signing in.

dashboard.title: See what to fix first
dashboard.subtitle: Start with single-page analysis and prioritize SEO, security, AI search readiness, and competitor gaps.
dashboard.previewNotice: This is a preview analysis. Sign in to save results and unlock the full report.

workspace.title: Workspace state
workspace.previewDescription: Try the public preview first, then sign in to unlock saved sites, reports, and workspace controls.
workspace.memberDescription: Saved sites, report surfaces, and workspace controls are active for this signed-in account.
workspace.adminDescription: This account can use the full workspace plus admin controls for authentication and environment health.
